<h1>Mountains</h1>
<p class="sg-lede">Blue pen, brush and linocut mountains, cut out of their paper: a high peak, a small peak, a peak above mist, a range with contour lines, a 1934 ridge sketch, a brush ridge, and a linocut of peaks over waves. Each in the blue it was drawn in, cobalt and black; the linocut also in three lighter blues. A candidate look for a sub-brand.</p>
<dl class="sg-facts"><dt>Use for</dt><dd>Landscape and distance: a sub-brand look, covers, and grounds for titles.</dd><dt>Colour</dt><dd>The blue each was drawn in, cobalt or black. The drawn blues are for the mountains only: don&#x27;t retint the mountains, and don&#x27;t print other graphics in those blues.</dd><dt>Grounds</dt><dd>White, Paper, Sunlight</dd><dt>Registers</dt><dd>Conversation, Gathering</dd><dt>Formats</dt><dd>PNG; the linocut also SVG</dd><dt>Rights</dt><dd>Not cleared. Traced or cut from mood board images whose rights are not cleared: fine for mockups and drafts; redraw, re-source or clear before anything goes public.</dd></dl>
<p class="sg-note">Pen and brush drawings are PNG only: their transparency follows the ink, so light hatching stays light.</p>
</header>
